objective_equals_title_note: Earlier batches intentionally encode atomic taxonomy nodes tersely. Canonical records preserve those objectives and add separate routing, completion, provenance, uncertainty, no-call, and safety contracts rather than fabricating task-specific details.
limitations: No automated or AI-only audit can establish task-by-task experimental truth across 10,000 scientific tasks. The release therefore makes no scientific-validation claim and requires current primary sources and qualified review.
Near-duplicate analysis is exhaustive within each 100-task domain, not across every cross-domain pair.
